object.description: The ID (GUID) of the Blend Track.

child.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object to assign. This object must be the child of a Blend Track's Blend Container.

index.description: The index of the child among the Blend Track's assignments. If a value is provided, it will be clamped to the range [0-n], where n is the current number of assignments. If a value is not provided, then the assignment will be added at the end.

edges.description: The configuration of the edges of the assignment within the Blend Track. This information is only useful if the Blend Track has a crossfade Game Parameter. If not specified, the edges will be configured using default values. If specified, there must be two edges: 0 = left, 1 = right.

items.description: The edge configuration of the Blend Track edge.
